title: Validated Batch 001 (Non-Legal Placeholder)

questions.prompt: Which repository area is the source-of-truth for approved questions used by the app?
questions.rationale: Validated question artifacts are promoted into data/questions_validated and used by the app.

rationale_by_choice.A: questions_raw contains drafts and should not be consumed as final study items.
rationale_by_choice.B: Correct. questions_validated stores approved question artifacts for runtime use.
rationale_by_choice.C: docs describe process and contracts but do not serve as runtime question banks.
rationale_by_choice.D: app/src contains application code, not source question content.

questions.prompt: What is the safest default behavior when changing shared content schemas?

choices.text: Keep changes minimal and document impact

questions.rationale: Schema changes should be minimal, explicit, and documented for downstream teams and tooling.

rationale_by_choice.A: Frequent undocumented schema changes break stability and trust.
rationale_by_choice.B: Correct. Minimal, explicit schema changes preserve compatibility and traceability.
rationale_by_choice.C: Skipping validation increases risk of broken pipelines and runtime errors.
rationale_by_choice.D: Hard-coded UI assumptions drift from source-of-truth contracts.

questions.prompt: In a one-question-at-a-time session, what should happen after the learner submits an answer?

choices.text: Immediately skip to the final score
Show correctness and per-choice rationale, then allow next

questions.rationale: Feedback should include why the right answer is right and why wrong answers are wrong before moving on.

rationale_by_choice.A: Skipping directly to summary removes critical learning feedback.
rationale_by_choice.C: Correct. Immediate rationale-driven feedback improves understanding.
rationale_by_choice.D: Session state is needed to continue and score the attempt.
